latest_normal_model_trial.method: Each process: Short16, then three alternating Code2K/Prose2K cycles (2048 input / 128 output). Discard cycle 0; median of cycles 1 and 2. Control is geometric mean of two preferred-process medians. Net decode excludes prefill, HTTP and startup.

tiered_draft.scope: Fixed greedy English/code; CJK/Cyrillic fallback functionally checked. Not a general multilingual speed or quality claim.

int8_kv.scope: Full draft vocabulary. INT8 is approximate and Prose output differs from FP16. Limited PPL results do not cover the tiered combination.

tiered_int8_combination.scope: Reverse decode drift exceeds the frozen 3% threshold for both tasks. Positive ratios are not stable combined gains.

limitations: This is an archive of existing measurements; no GPU benchmarks were rerun for the README refresh.
November 17 control rates are observations from one forward trial, not new paired speedups versus November 8 or SYCL.
Individual gains are not added. Earlier archived charts retain their original configurations.
No combined PPL or current-profile same-protocol Short28/8K performance result is established here.
